sql.query: SELECT top $rnum corp_nm, corp_reg_no,cp_code,ill_no, cpost, cp_addr, cp_jibun,rprstt_kr,cptel,cpfax, (select top (1) BASE_NAME from TB_APC_BASE_CODE where BASE_CODE = a.hcode and GROUP_CODE = '21' ) as hname, (select top (1) JISANAME from TB_APC_COMPANY_SUB where ji_code = a.ji_code ) as jiname, email,rp_hp,mb_no, tot_cnt FROM ( select company corp_nm, bsns_no corp_reg_no,cp_code,ill_no,hcode,ji_code,cptel,cpfax, cpost, cp_addr, cp_jibun,rprstt_kr,email,rp_hp, replace(replace(mb_no , '제', '' ), '호', '') mb_no, ROW_NUMBER() over( order by a.kname asc) rnum, COUNT(a.bsns_no) over() tot_cnt from tb_mb_master a where company is not null and company != '' and scode = '10' $addWhere )a where rnum > (?-1)*?

mapping.getProperty: corp_nm, corp_reg_no,cp_code,ill_no, cpost, cp_addr, cp_jibun,rprstt_kr,cptel,cpfax, hname,jiname,email,rp_hp, mb_no,tot_cnt

sql.query: SELECT start_dd, end_dd, std_yyyy, dbo.formatDateTime(GETDATE(),'yyyyMMdd') to_day, std_end_dd FROM TB_CYBER_SYSTEM WHERE active_yn = 'Y' and cast( start_dd + ' 00:00:00' as datetime) <= getdate() and cast( end_dd + ' 23:59:59' as datetime) >= getdate()
